title: Annular variation and dyadic absolute bounds for the triangular Hilbert transform

result.label: Annular variation and dyadic absolute bounds for the triangular Hilbert transform
result.statement: Proves maximal and annular r -variation bounds, for every r > 2, from complex L^3( R^2) L^3( R^2) to L^ 3/2 ( R^2). The maximal estimate controls both hard truncation endpoints and gives almost-everywhere and norm convergence. Pairing with a third input settles the triangular Hilbert transform estimate at the symmetric L^3 L^3 L^3 point.
